title: Real-time Collaboration & Performance
description: A major update introducing real-time collaboration features (Chat, Live Cursors) and significant performance optimizations for a fluid experience.

items.title: Real-time Collaboration
items.description: Collaborate with your team in real-time directly on dashboards.
details: **Dashboard Chat**: Integrated sidebar for discussing insights without leaving the data.
**Live Cursors**: See where other users are pointing and highlighting in real-time.
**Presence**: View active collaborators via avatars in the dashboard header.

items.title: Unified Share Menu
items.description: A consistent and powerful sharing experience across the application.
details: Easily manage permissions (Viewer/Editor) and public links from one place.

items.title: Responsive Dashboard
items.description: Dashboards now adapt perfectly to mobile screens.
details: **Stack View**: Grid items automatically stack on smaller screens for better readability.
**Mobile Chat**: Chat sidebar becomes a slide-over drawer on mobile.
**Optimized Header**: Navigation and actions are condensed for touch interactions.

items.title: Fluidity Improvements
items.description: Eliminated UI flickering and blocking states.
details: **Silent Schema Refresh**: Explorer sidebar updates connections in the background without clearing the list.
**Optimistic Saving**: moving and resizing dashboard widgets saves instantly in the UI while syncing in the background.

items.title: Initial Load Speed
items.description: Significant reduction in initial bundle size.
details: Lazy loaded heavy components (Code Editor, Excel Editor).
Implemented Route-level lazy loading for all main views.
